column1: # Sites each node checks every hour (host/vessel-reach.py): id, the region the site serves (global, tw, hk, mo, jp,
# sg; the status page groups by it, see web/src/reach.ts), address, and text only the real page has, so a challenge or a
# block page that answers 200 is not taken for the site. The ids are the names in web/src/i18n/*.json (reach.site.<id>).
# Left out: sites that challenge curl from anywhere (Cloudflare's "Just a moment": 健保署, 博客來, Dcard, Claude) and
# pages a script builds (TVer, ABEMA), which a check without a browser cannot tell apart from a block. WhatsApp's home
# page answers 400 to anything but a browser, so its robots.txt stands in for the site.
